english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for founding or setting up an organization, institution, or business.
Use this as the all-purpose verb for establishing an institution or organization.
Use this when institute means to establish or found an organization, institution, or company.
Use this for setting up an organization, company, committee, or similar body.
